_what: Grow Menagerie (rebuild-v2 M1): organisms the v2 page runs through the gated kernel (packages/neural-ca/typescript/src/nca_inference.wgsl) with their own weights. Built by packages/neural-ca/menagerie/build.py; measurements are the package's NumPy f32 reference of that kernel on the 64 x 64 dish (mask seed 42 for growth; seeds 42, 7, 11 for regrowth).

organisms.name: Disk
organisms.blurb: The committed checkpoint: the one the release gate re-runs bit for bit. It learned to persist, not to heal.

training.note: The package's committed checkpoint (neural-ca-emoji-disk), trained by its PyTorch path (neural_ca train) in the Persistent regime — a pool of grown states, no damage — on the two-tone disk target, then converted by convert_checkpoint.py.
